meta.title: Seafarer Tax Optimizer
meta.description: Find out which seafarer tax benefits you qualify for, and how much money you could save.

common.disclaimer: This tool provides an estimate only and is not tax advice. Please check current requirements with a tax advisor in your country.

home.heroSubtitle: Find out which tax benefits you qualify for, and how much money you could get back or save.
home.daysAtSeaLabel: Days at sea in the last 12 months
home.indiaDaysAtSeaHint: For India's NRI seafarer test, this should reflect days outside India for overseas employment. Days covered by a CDC-endorsed voyage starting or ending at an Indian port don't count as days in India, even if the vessel entered Indian waters during that voyage.
home.vesselFlagHint: Sometimes affects which benefits apply in your country.
home.annualIncomeHint: Only used to estimate a dollar savings figure where possible. Leave blank if unsure.
home.ukraineFamilyLocationLabel: Where do your immediate family / permanent home currently reside?
home.ukraineDaysInUkraineLabel: How many days did you physically spend in Ukraine over the last 12 months?
home.ukraineDaysInUkraineValidationError: Please enter a valid number of days in Ukraine (0–366).
home.polandInternationalTransportLabel: Is your vessel engaged in international transport of cargo/passengers by sea for at least 50% of your actual working time?
home.polandInternationalTransportHint: This excludes tugboats and dredgers whose international transport activity is under 50% of working time.
home.polandDttLabel: Is the shipowner's actual management/head office located in a country that has a double taxation treaty (DTT) with Poland?
home.polandDttHint: Common non-DTT flag/management countries include Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Barbados, Liberia.
home.voyageLogInvalidRangeError: Disembarkation date must be after embarkation date.
home.voyageLogExceeds366Warning: Total days across all voyages exceeds 366 — please double-check your entries.
home.validationError: Please enter a valid number of days at sea (0–366).
